358:     /// <summary>Returns true on success.</summary>
359:     private async Task<bool> StartDownloadAsync(string id, string title, bool showFolderWarning = true)
360:     {
361:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder))
362:         {
363:             if (showFolderWarning) MessageBox.Show("Choose a destination folder first.");
364:             return false;
365:         }
366: 
367:         var task = new DownloadTask
368:         {
369:             Id = id,
370:             Title = title,
371:             Status = "Downloading",
372:             StartedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt"),
373:         };
374:         _downloads.Insert(0, task);
375:         SaveDownloadHistory();
376: 
377:         // Batch 4: fetch this mod's preview thumbnail in the background so the
378:         // Downloads tab shows it even before a full history reload.
379:         _ = FetchTaskThumbnailAsync(task);
380: 
381:         StatusText.Text = $"Downloading {title}...";
382:         AppendLog($"Starting download: {title} ({id})");
383:         ProgressBarCtl.IsIndeterminate = true;
384:         try
385:         {
386:             var installedPaths = await SteamCmdService.DownloadModAsync(id, _settings.ModsFolder, line =>
387:             {
388:                 // SteamCMD's output arrives on a background thread.
389:                 Dispatcher.Invoke(() => task.Detail = line);
390:                 AppendLog(line, "DEBUG");
391:             });
392: 
393:             // Record the content manifest id (not a date) as the "version"
394:             // we now have locally, so future update-checks compare like for like.
395:             try
396:             {
397:                 var details = await WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync(id);
398:                 _settings.LocalModVersions[id] = details.ContentManifestId;
399:                 _settings.InstallDates[id] = DateTimeOffset.Now.ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
400:             }
401:             catch
402:             {
403:                 // Offline right after downloading -- leave whatever version
404:                 // was previously recorded (or none) rather than fail the download.
405:             }
406:             SettingsService.Save(_settings);
407: 
408:             task.Status = "Done";
409:             task.FinishedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt");
410:             task.Detail = installedPaths.Count == 1
411:                 ? $"Installed to \"{Path.GetFileName(installedPaths[0])}\""
412:                 : $"{installedPaths.Count} mod folders installed";
413: 
414:             StatusText.Text = installedPaths.Count == 1
415:                 ? $"Done: {title}"
416:                 : $"Done: {title} ({installedPaths.Count} mod folders installed)";
417:             AppendLog($"Finished: {title} \u2714 ({installedPaths.Count} folder(s))");
418:             SaveDownloadHistory();
419:             await RefreshDownloadedModsAsync();
420:             return true;
421:         }
422:         catch (Exception ex)
423:         {
424:             task.Status = "Failed";
425:             task.FinishedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt");
426:             task.Detail = ex.Message;
427:             StatusText.Text = $"Failed: {title} — {ex.Message}";
428:             AppendLog($"FAILED: {title} — {ex.Message}", "ERROR");
429:             SaveDownloadHistory();
430:             return false;
431:         }
432:         finally
433:         {
434:             ProgressBarCtl.IsIndeterminate = false;
435:         }
436:     }

474:     /// <summary>
475:     /// Figures out which Steam Workshop id a local mod folder corresponds to.
476:     /// Tries the "<id> <name>" naming convention this app installs mods
477:     /// under first, then falls back to scanning any mod.info file inside for
478:     /// a purely-numeric id= line (some mods happen to use one).
479:     /// </summary>
480:     private static bool TryExtractWorkshopId(string folderPath, out string id)
481:     {
482:         id = "";
483:         var name = Path.GetFileName(folderPath);
484:         if (name.StartsWith("_")) return false; // skip internal folders like _backups
485: 
486:         var m = Regex.Match(name, @"^(\d+)");
487:         if (m.Success)
488:         {
489:             id = m.Groups[1].Value;
490:             return true;
491:         }
492: 
493:         try
494:         {
495:             foreach (var infoFile in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folderPath, "mod.info", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
496:             {
497:                 foreach (var line in File.ReadAllLines(infoFile))
498:                 {
499:                     var lm = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^id\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
500:                     if (lm.Success)
501:                     {
502:                         id = lm.Groups[1].Value;
503:                         return true;
504:                     }
505:                 }
506:             }
507:         }
508:         catch
509:         {
510:             // Unreadable folder -- treat as unresolvable.
511:         }
512: 
513:         return false;
514:     }

516:     /// <summary>
517:     /// Normalizes a mod identifier for dependency matching: lowercase, remove
518:     /// spaces and punctuation, so "NeatUI_Framework" == "neatui framework" ==
519:     /// "NeatUI Framework" when comparing require= values against installed
520:     /// mods' id=/name= fields.
521:     /// </summary>
522:     private static string NormalizeModIdentifier(string value)
523:     {
524:         var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length);
525:         foreach (var c in value)
526:         {
527:             if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)) sb.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
528:         }
529:         return sb.ToString();
530:     }

615:     /// <summary>
616:     /// Scans the mods folder, pulls live details from Steam for each mod,
617:     /// and determines which ones need an update -- this single pass now
618:     /// covers both "list what's installed" and "check for updates" (the
619:     /// tabs used to be separate; merged so there's one source of truth).
620:     /// </summary>
621:     private async Task RefreshDownloadedModsAsync()
622:     {
623:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder) || !Directory.Exists(_settings.ModsFolder))
624:             return;
625: 
626:         AppendLog("Refreshing mod list and checking for updates...");
627:         var records = new List<ModRecord>();
628:         int updatesAvailable = 0;
629: 
630:         // Build an index of every installed mod's declared identifiers (id=/name=
631:         // from its mod.info) -> real workshop id (the numeric folder prefix), plus
632:         // the set of installed workshop ids. This lets require= entries (numeric
633:         // ids or internal names like "\NeatUI_Framework") be resolved purely
634:         // against what is already on disk -- no extra Steam API calls.
635:         var installedWorkshopIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
636:         var identifierIndex = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
637:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
638:         {
639:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var knownId)) continue;
640:             installedWorkshopIds.Add(knownId);
641:             foreach (var ident in SteamCmdService.GetModIdentifiers(dir))
642:             {
643:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(ident);
644:                 if (key.Length > 0) identifierIndex.TryAdd(key, knownId);
645:             }
646:         }
647: 
648:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
649:         {
650:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var id)) continue;
651:             var folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);
652: 
653:             // Resolve require= entries against the installed-mod index above.
654:             var requires = SteamCmdService.GetRequiresFields(dir);
655:             var missingDeps = new List<string>();
656:             foreach (var req in requires)
657:             {
658:                 bool met = long.TryParse(req, out _)
659:                     ? installedWorkshopIds.Contains(req)
660:                     : identifierIndex.TryGetValue(NormalizeModIdentifier(req), out _);
661:                 if (!met) missingDeps.Add(req);
662:             }
663: 
664:             string title = folderName, posted = "", updated = "", steamVer = "Unknown", creator = "";
665:             bool resolvedRemote = false;
666:             try
667:             {
668:                 var details = await WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync(id);
669:                 title = details.Title;
670:                 posted = details.TimeCreated == default ? "" : details.TimeCreated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
671:                 updated = details.TimeUpdated == default ? "" : details.TimeUpdated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
672:                 steamVer = string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId) ? "Unknown" : details.ContentManifestId;
673:                 resolvedRemote = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId);
674:                 creator = details.Creator;
675:             }
676:             catch
677:             {
678:                 // Offline, or the item was removed -- still show the folder by id.
679:             }
680: 
681:             var hasLocalVersion = _settings.LocalModVersions.TryGetValue(id, out var lv) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lv);
682:             var localVer = hasLocalVersion ? lv! : "Unknown";
683:             var installDate = _settings.InstallDates.TryGetValue(id, out var idate) ? idate : "";
684: 
685:             bool needsUpdate;
686:             if (!resolvedRemote)
687:                 needsUpdate = false; // couldn't reach Steam -- don't false-flag
688:             else if (!hasLocalVersion)
689:                 needsUpdate = true; // never tracked (e.g. placed manually) -- flag so the user can decide
690:             else
691:                 needsUpdate = !string.Equals(lv, steamVer, StringComparison.Ordinal);
692: 
693:             if (needsUpdate) updatesAvailable++;
694: 
695:             records.Add(new ModRecord
696:             {
697:                 Folder = folderName,
698:                 FullPath = dir,
699:                 Id = id,
700:                 ModName = title,
701:                 Size = FormatSize(GetDirectorySize(dir)),
702:                 Posted = posted,
703:                 Updated = updated,
704:                 LocalVersion = localVer,
705:                 SteamVersion = steamVer,
706:                 InstallDate = installDate,
707:                 NeedsUpdate = needsUpdate,
708:                 StatusLabel = needsUpdate ? "Update Available" : "Updated",
709:                 Creator = creator,
710:                 Dependencies = requires,
711:                 MissingDependencies = missingDeps,
712:                 MissingDepsCount = missingDeps.Count,
713:             });
714:         }
715: 
716:         _downloadedMods.Clear();
717:         foreach (var r in records) _downloadedMods.Add(r);
718: 
719:         UpdatesAvailableText.Text = $"Mods with updates available: {updatesAvailable}";

1021:     /// <summary>
1022:     /// Deletes the folder currently on disk for a mod before an update
1023:     /// redownloads it. This matters because SteamCMD's fresh download can
1024:     /// name the mod's folder slightly differently than what's already
1025:     /// installed (renamed subfolder, capitalization change, etc.) -- the
1026:     /// installer only overwrites a folder when the name matches exactly,
1027:     /// so without this step a mismatch leaves the old copy behind and
1028:     /// creates a duplicate instead of replacing it.
1029:     /// </summary>
1030:     private void RemoveOldModFolder(string folderName)
1031:     {
1032:         try
1033:         {
1034:             var path = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1035:             if (Directory.Exists(path)) Directory.Delete(path, recursive: true);
1036:         }
1037:         catch (Exception ex)
1038:         {
1039:             // Best-effort -- if this fails, the download will still overwrite
1040:             // any folder whose name happens to match exactly.
1041:             AppendLog($"Could not remove old folder \"{folderName}\" before redownload: {ex.Message}", "WARNING");
1042:         }
1043:     }
1044: 
1045:     private void BackupMod(string folderName)
1046:     {
1047:         try
1048:         {
1049:             var src = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1050:             if (!Directory.Exists(src)) return;
1051:             var backupDir = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, "_backups", folderName, DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
1052:             Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(backupDir)!);
1053:             CopyDirectory(src, backupDir);
1054:         }
1055:         catch
1056:         {
1057:             // Best-effort backup; don't block the update if it fails.
1058:         }
1059:     }
1060: 
1061:     private static void CopyDirectory(string sourceDir, string destDir)
1062:     {
1063:         Directory.CreateDirectory(destDir);
1064:         foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir))
1065:             File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(file)), overwrite: true);
1066:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(sourceDir))
1067:             CopyDirectory(dir, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(dir)));
1068:     }

1102:     /// <summary>
1103:     /// "Show Deps" button on an Installed Mods row. The Steam Workshop page for
1104:     /// the selected mod is the authoritative source of its dependencies: the
1105:     /// "Required items" section lists every dependency (workshop id + name),
1106:     /// whether or not it's installed. So the popup is populated from that page
1107:     /// and each entry is annotated installed/missing by comparing its workshop id
1108:     /// against the installed-mod index.
1109:     ///
1110:     /// This lookup happens ONLY here, on explicit user action -- never during
1111:     /// startup or the Installed Mods refresh -- and fetches ONLY this mod's page
1112:     /// (no recursive dependency-page requests). Results are cached per session
1113:     /// and concurrent duplicate clicks are ignored.
1114:     /// </summary>
1115:     private async void ShowDeps_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
1116:     {
1117:         if (sender is not FrameworkElement fe || fe.Tag is not ModRecord mod) return;
1118: 
1119:         // Authoritative installed-workshop-id set for the installed/missing flag.
1120:         var installedIds = _downloadedMods.Select(m => m.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
1121: 
1122:         // Fetch ONLY this mod's page. Per-session cache avoids re-downloading;
1123:         // the in-flight guard drops duplicate clicks while a fetch is running.
1124:         List<WorkshopRequiredItem> pageItems;
1125:         string? pageError = null;
1126:         if (_depsPageCache.TryGetValue(mod.Id, out var cached))
1127:         {
1128:             pageItems = cached;
1129:         }
1130:         else if (!_depsFetchInFlight.Add(mod.Id))
1131:         {
1132:             AppendLog($"Dependency lookup for \"{mod.ModName}\" is already in progress; ignoring repeat click.", "WARNING");
1133:             return;
1134:         }
1135:         else
1136:         {
1137:             try
1138:             {
1139:                 pageItems = await WorkshopPageService.GetRequiredItemsAsync(mod.Id);
1140:                 _depsPageCache[mod.Id] = pageItems;
1141:                 if (pageItems.Count > 0)
1142:                     AppendLog($"Loaded {pageItems.Count} required item link(s) from the Workshop page for \"{mod.ModName}\".");
1143:             }
1144:             catch (Exception ex)
1145:             {
1146:                 pageItems = new List<WorkshopRequiredItem>();
1147:                 pageError = ex.Message;
1148:                 AppendLog($"Could not read required items from the Workshop page for \"{mod.ModName}\": {ex.Message}", "WARNING");
1149:             }
1150:             finally
1151:             {
1152:                 _depsFetchInFlight.Remove(mod.Id);
1153:             }
1154:         }
1155: 
1156:         // The page is authoritative: show every required item, installed or not.
1157:         var displays = new List<DepDisplay>();
1158:         foreach (var pi in pageItems)
1159:         {
1160:             displays.Add(new DepDisplay
1161:             {
1162:                 Identifier = pi.Id,
1163:                 Title = pi.Title,
1164:                 WorkshopId = pi.Id,
1165:                 IsMissing = !installedIds.Contains(pi.Id),
1166:             });
1167:         }
1168: 
1169:         // Safety net for mods whose Steam page has no "Required items" section:
1170:         // fall back to mod.info require= resolution so locally-known deps still show.
1171:         if (displays.Count == 0)
1172:             displays = BuildModInfoDisplays(mod);
1173: 
1174:         var dlg = new DepsDialog(
1175:             mod.ModName,
1176:             displays,
1177:             queueOne: d => AddDependencyToQueue(d),
1178:             openPage: d => OpenDependencyPage(d))
1179:         { Owner = this };
1180: 
1181:         if (pageError != null)
1182:             dlg.ShowError($"Could not load the Workshop page for \"{mod.ModName}\":\n{pageError}\n\n" +
1183:                           (displays.Count > 0 ? "Showing locally-known requirements instead." : ""));
1184: 
1185:         dlg.ShowDialog();
1186:     }
1187: 
1188:     /// <summary>
1189:     /// Fallback used when the Workshop page has no required-items section:
1190:     /// resolves the mod.info require= entries against installed mods'
1191:     /// id=/name= identifiers (numeric entries are already workshop ids).
1192:     /// </summary>
1193:     private List<DepDisplay> BuildModInfoDisplays(ModRecord mod)
1194:     {
1195:         var installedIndex = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1196:         foreach (var installed in _downloadedMods)
1197:         {
1198:             foreach (var ident in SteamCmdService.GetModIdentifiers(installed.FullPath))
1199:             {
1200:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(ident);
1201:                 if (key.Length > 0) installedIndex.TryAdd(key, installed.Id);
1202:             }
1203:         }
1204: 
1205:         var displays = new List<DepDisplay>();
1206:         foreach (var req in mod.Dependencies)
1207:         {
1208:             string? wsId = null;
1209:             string title = req;
1210: 
1211:             if (long.TryParse(req, out _))
1212:             {
1213:                 wsId = req; // numeric require= is already the workshop id
1214:                 var installed = _downloadedMods.FirstOrDefault(m => m.Id == req);
1215:                 if (installed != null) title = installed.ModName;
1216:             }
1217:             else
1218:             {
1219:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(req);
1220:                 if (installedIndex.TryGetValue(key, out var localId))
1221:                 {
1222:                     wsId = localId; // matched against an installed mod
1223:                     var installed = _downloadedMods.FirstOrDefault(m => m.Id == localId);
1224:                     if (installed != null) title = installed.ModName;
1225:                 }
1226:             }
1227: 
1228:             displays.Add(new DepDisplay
1229:             {
1230:                 Identifier = req,
1231:                 Title = title,
1232:                 WorkshopId = wsId,
1233:                 IsMissing = wsId == null || !_downloadedMods.Any(m => m.Id == wsId),
1234:             });
1235:         }
1236:         return displays;
1237:     }

1244:         AppendLog($"Queued dependency: {d.Title} ({d.WorkshopId})");

45:         {

<Window x:Class="PZWorkshopDownloader.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:wv2="clr-namespace:Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf;assembly=Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf"
        Title="Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader"
        Height="880" Width="1300" MinHeight="600" MinWidth="900"
        FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"
        Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Batch 4: shared tile thumbnail block (initial-letter placeholder until
             ThumbnailPath arrives; the image then covers it). Width/Height follow
             the app-wide ModTileSize resource so the slider resizes every tile. -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="TileThumbnail">
            <Grid Width="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}" Height="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}">
                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="6"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="26" FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </Border>
                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="2.5">
                    <Image.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Image.Style>
                </Image>
            </Grid>
        </DataTemplate>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="DownloadsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Remove From List" Click="RemoveDownloadEntry_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="InstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Folder" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.FullPath, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Update This Mod" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.NeedsUpdate, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Force Redownload" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Show Dependencies" Click="ShowDeps_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.HasDependencies, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Uninstall" Click="UninstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="UninstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Reinstall" Click="ReinstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Forget" Click="ForgetUninstalledMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <!-- ============ Tile mode (Batch 4) ============
             Shared styles so all three tile grids stay consistent.
             NOTE: we pulse via Opacity (DoubleAnimation), never by animating a
             brush Color. WPF freezes SolidColorBrush instances inside shared
             DataTemplates, so ColorAnimation on (Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)
             throws "Cannot animate on an immutable object instance". -->

        <!-- Common chrome for every tile button. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Mod name text (Installed tiles turn orange+bold when an update is out). -->
        <Style x:Key="TileNameTextStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="MaxHeight" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,2"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Status line shared appearance. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileStatusTextBase" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Update status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when NeedsUpdate. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileUpdateStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileUpdatePulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileUpdatePulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Requirement status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when HasMissingDeps. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileRequirementStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileRequirementPulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileRequirementPulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="QueueColumn" Width="0"/>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <TabControl x:Name="MainTabs" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                    BorderThickness="0" Margin="0">

            <!-- ============ BROWSER TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Browser" x:Name="BrowserTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Address bar -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,4">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="◀" Click="Back_Click" ToolTip="Back"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="▶" Click="Forward_Click" ToolTip="Forward"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="⌂" Click="Home_Click" ToolTip="Workshop Home"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="AddressBar" Grid.Column="3" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                 VerticalContentAlignment="Center" KeyDown="AddressBar_KeyDown"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Action buttons -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,0,8,6">
                        <TextBlock Text="Folder:" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="3"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="DestFolderLabel" Text="Not set" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" MaxWidth="260"
                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        <Button Content="Download This Mod/Collection" Click="DownloadCurrent_Click" Margin="20,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Content="Add To Queue" Click="AddToQueue_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Browser -->
                    <wv2:WebView2 x:Name="Browser" Grid.Row="2"
                                  Source="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=108600&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems"/>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ DOWNLOADS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Downloads">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Button Content="Clear Finished" Click="ClearFinishedDownloads_Click"/>
                        <Button Content="Clear All" Click="ClearAllDownloads_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">

<ContentControl Content="{Binding}" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource TileThumbnail}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding ModName}" Style="{StaticResource TileNameTextStyle}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding UninstallDate}" Style="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ SETTINGS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Settings">
                <StackPanel Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}" Margin="16">
                    <TextBlock Text="Mods Folder" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Where mods are downloaded to and installed for Project Zomboid to find them."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,24">
                        <TextBox x:Name="PzFolderBox" Width="520" IsReadOnly="True" VerticalContentAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Button Content="Browse..." Click="OpenPzFolder_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <TextBlock Text="Options" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="BackupCheckbox" Content="Backup updated mods before overwriting"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="AutoRefreshCheckbox" Content="Auto-refresh mod list when switching to Installed Mods tab"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <CheckBox x:Name="DebugLoggingCheckbox" Content="Show debug-level messages in the log panel (verbose SteamCMD output)"
                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="Theme" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <ComboBox x:Name="ThemeCombo" Width="220" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                              SelectionChanged="ThemeCombo_SelectionChanged">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Midnight"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Forest"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Nord"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dracula"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Gruvbox"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Monokai"/>
                    </ComboBox>

                    <TextBlock Text="UI Customization" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,24,0,10"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Font sizes apply live. Scroll speed multiplies the mouse-wheel step of the tables and lists."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="General text size:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontGeneralSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontGeneralLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Buttons:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontButtonsSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontButtonsLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Tab headers:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontTabsSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontTabsLabel" Text="13" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <TextBlock Text="Log panel:" Width="160" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        <Slider x:Name="FontLogSlider" Width="220" Minimum="8" Maximum="18" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontLogLabel" Text="11" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Button Content="Reset UI to Defaults" Click="ResetUi_Click" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                            Padding="16,6" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Resets the font sizes above. Does not touch the mods folder, theme, or other settings."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

                    <Button Content="About" Click="AboutButton_Click" HorizontalAlignment="Left" Margin="0,24,0,0" Padding="16,6"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </TabItem>

        </TabControl>

        <!-- ============ QUEUE SIDE PANEL (window-level, right side; auto-shows when mods are queued) ============ -->
        <Border x:Name="QueuePanel" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" Visibility="Collapsed"
                Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1,0,0,0">
            <DockPanel Margin="6">
                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="Download Queue" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                           FontWeight="Bold" Margin="4,4,4,8"/>
                <Button DockPanel.Dock="Top" Content="Start Downloading All" Click="StartQueue_Click"
                        Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                <Button DockPanel.Dock="Top" Content="Clear Queue" Click="ClearQueue_Click"/>
                <ListBox x:Name="QueueList" Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <StackPanel Margin="0,4">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" FontSize="12"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" FontSize="11"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                </ListBox>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ============ BOTTOM LOG / STATUS PANEL (window-level, visible from every tab) ============ -->
        <Border Grid.Row="1" Grid.ColumnSpan="2" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
            <StackPanel>
                <Grid Margin="8,4">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" Grid.Column="0" Text="Waiting..."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
                    <ProgressBar x:Name="ProgressBarCtl" Grid.Column="1" Height="14" IsIndeterminate="False"/>
                    <ToggleButton x:Name="LogToggle" Grid.Column="2" Content="Show Log ▲" Click="ToggleLog_Click"
                                  Margin="10,0,0,0" Padding="8,3"/>
                </Grid>
                <Border x:Name="LogPanelBorder" Height="0" ClipToBounds="True" Background="{DynamicResource BgField}"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="6,4">
                            <Button Content="Clear Log" Click="ClearLogButton_Click" Padding="8,3"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <Grid Grid.Row="1">
                            <ListBox x:Name="LogList" Background="Transparent" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"
                                     BorderThickness="0" FontFamily="Consolas" FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeLog}" Padding="6">
                                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayText}" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="DEBUG">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#8A97A3"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="WARNING">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFA500"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="ERROR">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF6B6B"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                            </ListBox>
                            <Button x:Name="JumpToBottomButton" Content="Jump to Bottom ▼" Click="JumpToBottomButton_Click"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Visibility="Collapsed" Background="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" Foreground="Black" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
</Window>

    <Grid Margin="12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>

</Window>

I've inspected all the source code. Here's what the application is and how it works.

## What this application is

A single-project, .NET 8 WPF Desktop app (the only NuGet dependency is `Microsoft.Web.WebView2`) that is a **custom Steam Workshop browser + mod manager for Project Zomboid** (AppId `108600`). You browse the real Steam Workshop inside an embedded WebView, download Workshop items via SteamCMD into a folder PZ looks in, then scan/verify/backup/update/uninstall those mods. It persists a small pile of JSON state under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\`.

## High‑level flow (how the parts work together)

1. **Browser tab** points `WebView2` at the PZ Workshop. You browse like a normal site; the app reads the *numeric* Workshop id out of the URL and the mod's title out of the document title.
2. **"Download This Mod/Collection"** resolves that id → `SteamCmdService.DownloadModAsync` → (first run) bootstraps SteamCMD, then runs `workshop_download_item 108600 <id>` into a private SteamCMD sandbox.
3. On success the item's real mod folder(s) are copied out of the Steam cache into `<yourModsFolder>/<workshopId> <DisplayName>` — the layout PZ actually loads. `WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync` fetches the live `hcontent_file` manifest id, which is recorded as the mod's "version" (`LocalModVersions`) and an install timestamp (`InstallDates`) — both saved to `settings.json`.
4. **Installed Mods tab** rescans that folder: extracts each folder's Workshop id, calls the same API to compare live vs. locally‑recorded version (detecting updates), resolves `require=` deps locally against the other installed mocks, and kicks off a background fetch of previews/tags/thumbnails.
5. **Queue** (a window‑level side panel, not a tab) batches several ids; "Start Downloading All" runs them one at a time.

The four things that "identify" a mod come in pairs, and the code is careful to keep them distinct:

- The **real Workshop id** is numeric; it lives in the folder‑name prefix `^(\d+)` and the item URL, and is the only identity used at the filesystem/API level.
- The letter‑based `id=`/`name=` fields inside `mod.info` are *never* used to identify a mod — they're read (`GetModIdentifiers`) only to resolve a `require=` reference back to an already‑installed mod, and normalized (`NormalizeModIdentifier` = lowercase alphanumerics) so `NeatUI_Framework` == `neatui framework`.
- The **version** is Steam's `hcontent_file` (`ContentManifestId`), not `time_updated`.
- The **folder naming** is `<workshopId> <DisplayName>`, where DisplayName comes from `mod.info name=` (a human‑readable name), not the raw Steam subfolder name.

## Project structure

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `PZWorkshopDownloader.csproj` | Single WPF project, net8.0‑win, x64, only dep `Microsoft.Web.WebView2`. |
| `App.xaml` / `.cs` | Entry point. Holds theme brushes + the 4 `sys:Double` font‑size resources and their `DynamicResource` consumers. `App.xaml.cs` wires three global unhandled‑exception handlers → `crash.log` + message box. |
| `MainWindow.xaml` / `.cs` | The hub (~1100 lines of XAML + code): all tabs, the queue panel, download flow, scan/update, deps, theming, log panel, settings. |
| `Services/SteamCmdService.cs` | Owns SteamCMD: downloads `steamcmd.zip` on first run, bootstraps (`+quit`), and runs the real download. Also parses `mod.info` (`GetModDisplayName`, `GetRequiresFields`, `GetModIdentifiers`). |
| `Services/WorkshopApiService.cs` | `GetDetailsAsync` — one‑item `GetPublishedFileDetails` for title/dates/creator/`hcontent_file`. (Intentionally minimal; not meant to grow.) |
| `Services/WorkshopVisualService.cs` | Batched (≤100 ids) fetch of `preview_url` + tags for thumbnails and the tag sidebar. |
| `Services/WorkshopPageService.cs` | Best‑effort HTML parse of a mod page's "Required items" section, for the Show‑Deps dialog. |
| `Services/SettingsService.cs` | `settings.json` load/save (`AppSettings`). |
| `Services/DownloadHistoryStore.cs` / `UninstalledModsStore.cs` | JSON persistence for the Downloads history (cap 300) and uninstalled list. |
| `Services/ThumbnailStore.cs` | Local thumbnail cache `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\thumbnails\<id>.jpg`. |
| `Models/…` | Plain (mostly INPC) DTOs: `ModRecord`, `DownloadTask`, `QueueItem`, `UninstalledModEntry`, `DownloadHistoryEntry`, `LogEntry`. |
| `DepsDialog.xaml(.cs)` | Modal `DepsDialog` + `DepDisplay` row. |
| `AboutWindow.xaml(.cs)` | About dialog. |
| `build.bat` / `run-debug.bat` | Restore + publish (self‑contained win‑x64, whole `dist/` ships) / `dotnet run` with console. |

## Main tabs / components and what each does

**Browser** (`BrowserTabItem`, WebView2) — navigation bar (back/forward/home), address bar (Enter navigates; plain text becomes a Workshop `?searchtext=`), a `Folder:` label, and the two action buttons. `DownloadCurrent_Click` and `AddToQueue_Click` both call `GetCurrentWorkshopId()` (regex on the URL) — the single source of "which mod am I looking at."

**Downloads** — the persistent download‑history grid/tiles (`DownloadTask` entries, newest first). Each attempt is a new row (retries add rows), so it doubles as a log. `SaveDownloadHistory` writes to `download_history.json` (capped at 300). "Clear Finished" / "Clear All", per‑row context‑menu removal, and right‑click context menus to `ModPage_Click` etc. Thumbnails fill in from `LoadDownloadsThumbnailsAsync`/`FetchTaskThumbnailAsync`.

**Installed Mods** (also the updater) — `RefreshDownloadedModsAsync` is the one pass that lists *and* checks updates:

- Walks `<modsFolder>` dirs, extracting the numeric id via `TryExtractWorkshopId` (skips `_backups`).
- Builds a local `installedWorkshopIds` set + `identifierIndex` from each mod's `id=`/`name=` — used to resolve `require=` **with zero extra Steam API calls**; missing deps become `MissingDependencies`/`MissingDepsCount`.
- Per mod, calls `GetDetailsAsync` for title/dates/creator/manifest `steamVer`; sets `needsUpdate` by comparing to `LocalModVersions[id]`; treats a never‑tracked folder as "needs update" so the user can decide.
- Populates the grid/tiles, updates `UpdatesAvailableText`, enables `UpdateAllButton`, then fires `LoadInstalledVisualsAsync`.

The visual pipeline (`WorkshopVisualService` + `ThumbnailStore`) is throttled by `ThumbnailGate = new SemaphoreSlim(4)` so a big mod list doesn't hammer the CDN; a per‑mod `ThumbnailPath` raises `PropertyChanged` so grids/tiles update in place.

Updates: `UpdateAllButton` (loops `NeedsUpdate`, `BackupMod` → `RemoveOldModFolder` → `StartDownloadAsync`); per‑row "Update this mod" (shown only when `NeedsUpdate`) and "Force Redownload" both funnel into `ForceRedownloadAsync`. `BackupMod` copies to `_backups/<folder>/<timestamp>`; `RemoveOldModFolder` deletes the old folder first (SteamCMD only overwrites an exact‑matching folder name, so a renamed mod would otherwise leave a duplicate).

**Dependency handling** — `require=` entries are either a numeric Workshop id or a backslash‑prefixed internal name. The grid shows `RequirementLabel` and pulses (the same `DataTrigger` + `BeginStoryboard`/`ColorAnimation` pattern as the update column) when `HasMissingDeps`. "Show Deps" (`ShowDeps_Click`) fetches *only* this mod's page (`WorkshopPageService`, cached per session, in‑flight guard) for the authoritative "Required items", annotating each as installed/missing; if the page has no required‑items section it falls back to `BuildModInfoDisplays` (local resolution). `DepsDialog` then offers Queue / Open page / Add All; name‑only deps open a Steam search instead.

**Uninstalled Mods** — `UninstallMod_Click` deletes the folder (confirm), records `UninstalledModEntry` + `UninstalledModsStore.Save`; rows offer Reinstall / Open Page / Forget. Stored in `uninstalled_mods.json`.

**Settings** — the shared "PZ Folder" (download dest = scan folder, one unified setting), `BackupUpdatedMods`, `AutoRefreshOnTabSwitch`, `DebugLogging`, the 10‑option `Theme` combo, and the 4 live font‑size sliders. Theme = 10 palettes applied by `SetBrush` *replacing* the resource (WPF freezes XAML‑declared brushes, so you replace, don't mutate). Font sizes update the app‑level `sys:Double` resources live.

**Queue side panel** (window‑level, not a tab) — auto‑shows when `_queue` gets an item, auto‑hides when cleared; "Start Downloading All" runs sequentially.

**Bottom panel** (window‑level) — status text + indeterminate progress bar + expandable log. `AppendLog` is dispatcher‑safe, caps at 500 entries, auto‑scrolls only if already at the bottom, else reveals a "Jump to Bottom" button; DEBUG lines are hidden unless `DebugLogging` is on.

**Cross‑cutting pieces**

- **Mod list Import/Export** — `ExportModList_Click`/`ImportModList_Click` round‑trip a `<ModList>`/`<Mod>` XML; import queues un‑installed ids and skips already‑installed/queued.
- **The "version" mechanism** is the heart of update detection: `hcontent_file` is stored per mod at download time and compared to the live value — robust to metadata edits, unlike `time_updated`.
- **Theming/typography** live as `DynamicResource` brushes + `sys:Double` font resources; `SetBrush` swaps the resource entry so the frozen XAML brushes are never mutated.

Build is .NET 8 WPF with the WebView2 package; `build.bat` does `restore` + `publish` (self‑contained win‑x64, whole `dist/` ships). No tests, no lint, no CI.

```csharp
    // ================= Batch 5: Workshop content cache clear =================

    /// <summary>
    /// Clears the cached Workshop mod contents under
    /// steamapps/workshop/content/108600 (SteamCMD itself stays).
    /// Confirm before clearing.
    /// </summary>
    private async void ClearContentCache_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        // Delete while downloading would get corrupted.
        if (ProgressBarCtl.IsIndeterminate)
        {
            MessageBox.Show("A download is in progress. Wait for it to finish before clearing the cache.");
            return;
        }

        var root = SteamCmdService.GetCacheContentRoot();
        if (!Directory.Exists(root))
        {
            StatusText.Text = "No Workshop cache to clear.";
            AppendLog("Clear Workshop Cache: no cached Workshop content found.");
            return;
        }

        var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
            $"Delete all cached Workshop mod contents from:\n\n{root}\n\n" +
            "Only the cached mod contents are deleted — SteamCMD itself is not touched.",
            "Clear Workshop Cache", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
        if (confirm != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

        int removed = await Task.Run(() => SteamCmdService.ClearContentCache());
        StatusText.Text = $"Cleared {removed} cached mod folder(s).";
        AppendLog($"Cleared Workshop cache, removed {removed} folder(s) under {root}");
    }
```

I need my about window looks a little busy. Let me reconsider the design of the About window.

What I added is:
- The "Open GitHub Repository" button
- A GitHub note text (this is now stale and meaningless. Since the repo has been configured)
- A hyperlink

Having both a button and a hyperlink pointing to the same destination is redundant and cluttered. The user is asking to "add a GitHub link to the section/button on the about in the settings tab."

Actually, re-reading: "Add this GitHub link to the section/button in the settings tab about." So they're saying that there's a button in the settings tab for "About" (the About button under settings). Maybe that's what they mean by "the settings tab about section/button." Actually, on the settings tab there's an "About" button that opens the AboutWindow.

So "add this GitHub link to the button in the settings tab about" — about window. They want a link to that GitHub URL placed in the About window.

**1. Clear cached Workshop mods button**
- Added a `Clear Cached Workshop Mods` button in the Settings tab (MainWindow.xaml:804) with descriptive helper text.
- New `ClearCache_Click` handler (MainWindow.xaml.cs). It shows a Yes/No confirm dialog that names the exact `steamapps/workshop/content/108600/` path, then calls the already-present `SteamCmdService.ClearContentCache()`, which deletes only the cached mod folders and returns the count removed. It logs the result and toasts any failure. `ClearContentCache` deletes the `108600/` sub-folders only, leaving `steamcmd.exe` itself untouched.

**2. GitHub link in the About dialog**
- Added a clickable `Hyperlink` styled with the theme accent color that points to the URL, opened via `GitHubButton_Click` and a new `GitHubLink_Click` handler. Replaced the stale "no repository configured" dead-code branch in `AboutWindow.xaml.cs` and set `GitHubUrl` to the real URL so the "Open GitHub Repository" button works too.

**3. Tile-size slider hidden in List mode**
- Gave each per-tab slider and label their own `x:Name` (e.g. `DownloadsTileSlider`/`DownloadsTileSliderLabel`) and set them `Collapsed` in XAML so the initial List-mode state is correct.
- Added `SetTileSliderVisibility(bool)`; all three `*View_Checked` handlers call it with the current mode, so switching List→Tiles reveals the slider and immediate Tile→List hides it. The tile-size resource itself is still the single shared app-level value.
